description: Light elf clients: formal, proud, condescending, evasive. They offer commissions as favours.

l-hail: Ah. You are punctual. How refreshing.
You are the captain I was told of. Do sit.
I shall be plain, as I am told humans prefer.
One hopes the journey here was tolerable.
I trust I need not explain who I am.
Captain. You will forgive me if I do not rise.
l-intro: {faction} has seen fit to approach you.
My house has a matter that requires an outside hand.
I speak for {faction}, in a rather limited capacity.
I am {client}. The name will mean something to those who matter.
This is a commission, not a favour, though you may feel otherwise.
We rarely engage outsiders. Consider yourself noted.
l-frame: The matter is simple, and I shall explain it slowly.
I shall spare you the history. You would not follow it.
I require something done properly, which is rare.
It is a modest affair, but not a trivial one.
I will say only what you need, and perhaps a little less.
It concerns an arrangement of long standing.
l-clock: Time is not unlimited, however it may appear to you.
You have {deadline}. I should not like to be disappointed.
Haste is vulgar, but lateness is worse. {deadline}.
I would have it settled in {deadline}.
We are already later than I would wish.
l-clock2: I shall be counting, if you are not.
l-stakes: There are those who would be embarrassed by a delay.
Certain parties are watching, and keeping their opinions to themselves.
A matter of standing depends on it.
I would not like it said that my house was slow.
Old arrangements have a way of lapsing at inconvenient hours.
It would reflect poorly on all of us.
l-offer: You will be compensated with {reward}, which I believe is generous.
{reward}. I consider that fair, and you may consider it likewise.
The fee is {reward}. I do not bargain.
Your remuneration is {reward}, as befits the task.
l-terms: It will be settled in good order, upon completion.
I shall pay when satisfied, not before.
Payment follows proof, as is proper.
I do not renege, whatever you have heard.
Do not ask for an advance. It is unbecoming.
The sum will be delivered discreetly.
l-barb: I imagine that is more than you are used to.
It is, I am told, a respectable sum among your kind.
I am aware it is less than the work deserves. Be gracious about it.
l-caution: Be discreet. Our affairs are not for public conversation.
Do not ask who else has an interest. You would not like the answer.
Some will wish to know what you carry. Disappoint them.
You will be watched, I think. Carry on regardless.
Do not mention my name to anyone of consequence.
There are old quarrels in play that do not concern you.
I advise you not to be curious.
l-caution2: Curiosity has ended better careers than yours.
I do not require your opinion on the matter.
Some knowledge is better left where it lies.
l-conseq: Should you fail, I shall be disappointed, and I am rarely merely that.
I will not intervene on your behalf.
My patience is considerable, but it has a floor.
Do not expect my house to acknowledge you in public.
If you speak out of turn, the commission lapses.
l-send: I thank you, for what that is worth.
l-part: I will not say it twice.
Try to be worthy of the trust.
I have faith, though it is thin.
Do prove me wrong about your kind.
We shall speak again, should you succeed.
